tei:div.tei:p: 131) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: rig 'dzin sgrub thabs byin rlabs sprin phung bzhugs: na mo pad+ma kā ra ye:

o rgyan rdo rje 'chang la 'dud: chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi: cha lag rig 'dzin sgrub thabs ni: spros med rgyun khyer zab mo mchog: skal ldan bu yi don du bstan: sa ma ya: sngon 'gro rang rgyud sbyong ba ni: na mo: bde gshegs kun 'dus pad+ma rgyal: bdag sogs gus pas skyabs su mchi: ma gyur 'gro ba kun don du: smon 'jug don dam byang sems bskyed: lan gsum dang: dngos gzhi lha yi sa ma ti: āḥ ka dag zang thal de bzhin nyidaḥ gsal mdangs ma 'gags snying rje'i rtsal: hrīḥyig yongs su gyur pa las: rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su: mtsho skyes rdo rje sprul pa'i sku: dkar dmar mdangs ldan zhal gcig pa: phyag gnyis rdo rje bhan thod 'dzin: gsal stong cha lugs yongs su rdzogs: zhabs gnyis rol stabs pad zlar bzhugs: 'ja' 'od 'khyil klong 'od zer 'bar: snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: gnas gsum 'bru gsum sa bon las: 'od 'phros sku gsum zhing khams nas: 132) rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha tshogs rnams: spyan drangs dam ye dbyer med bstim: thugs kar hrīḥyig mtha' skor du: rtsa ba'i sngags kyis g.yas su 'khor: 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas: sgra grags sngags dang dran rtog thugs: khyer so gsum ldan ngang du bzlas: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: zhes pa brgya stong khri 'bum dang: bye ba bzlas pas rig 'dzin gyis: rab dngos 'bring nyams rmi lam du: zhal gzigs dbugs dbyung 'thob par 'gyur: rtags mtshan lag tu longs dang gsal: don gnyis 'grub par the tshom med: tshe ring mched lngas gnyer gyis shig: skal ldan bu dang 'phrad par shog: skal med rnams dang 'di ma 'phrad: log lta can gyi snying khrag bzhes: yal bar ma dor sa ma ya: sku rgya: gsung rgya: thugs rgya: brda thim : gu h+ya: (Dakini secret letter here) : zhes pa rig 'dzin sgrub thabs spros med rgyun khyer 'di yang dad ldan bsod dpal gyis dar bcas bskul ngor ma ldog tsam du su kha badz+ra gyis bris pa'o//

dge'o// ༈ mchod bstod ni: oṃ gu ru bid+yā dha ra sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ= sogs nas: shap+da sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rak+ta ba liṃ ta sarba pū dza khā hiḥ mi 'gyur spros bral chos sku: mi 'gag mnyam nyid rig pa'i gsung: smra 133)bsam brjod bral skye med thugs: yon tan phrin las rdzogs la bstod: dge bas 'gro ba sems can kun: rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing khams su: rig 'dzin pad+ma'i zhabs drung du: skyes nas rnam mkhyen sa 'thob shog: ces su kha'i ming gis so// 134)
